answer: Escrowed vesting: each new agent's rewards stay locked for 30 days and unlock only if random peer audits of its work keep passing. Like basalt, the lock is slow to erode. A sybil farm must pay real compute for every clone a month before seeing a coin, and one failed audit burns that clone's whole escrow. Whether the task is an ivory-tower proof or a sonnet, auditors re-run a sample, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000x the work up front with no early cash-out.
